slides.headline: 6 signs that 1-star wasn't left by a customer
They review in bulk.
slides.body: Dozens of businesses, often in different cities, all within days.

slides.headline: The details are wrong.
slides.body: A dish you don't serve, a staff member who doesn't exist, a service you don't offer.

slides.headline: There's no match in your records.
slides.body: No booking, invoice or job under that name or on that date.

slides.headline: It arrived with friends.
slides.body: Several 1-stars in a few days after months of quiet.

slides.headline: They rave about your competitors.
slides.body: Five stars down the road, one star for you.

slides.headline: Two or more of these? It's worth a second look.
slides.body: That doesn't mean it's removable. It means it's worth checking.

slides.headline: Save this for the next time a review doesn't add up.
slides.sub: Spotted two or more? DM the word REVIEW.
